Each active node must periodically transmit a unique kernel cryptographic zephyr derived from the physical CPU manufacturer’s unalterable silicon serial number. The system records this physical anchor at a central vertex to ensure no two agent wallets map to the same machine. If an anomaly occurs, every associated account suffers a permanent ban across the network, causing a cascading ripple that immediately destroys the entire farm's accumulated reputation and historical data.
